remarks: Fully updated - Renovated - 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath condo offering three levels of comfortable living in a fantastic community setting. This spacious home features an under-house garage with parking directly in front of the garage PLUS an additional designated parking space. Inside, you'll find a bright and modern layout with a beautifully updated kitchen, stylish finishes throughout, and great natural light. The lower level offers laundry and a bonus room-perfect as a 4th bedroom, home office, playroom, or extra TV room. Enjoy access to the community pool, making warm-weather months feel like your own private getaway. Tenant only pays electric, cable, and internet. All other essentials are included, making budgeting simple and stress-free. Occupancy may be available ASAP-please contact the listing agent for details and confirmation. This is a rare opportunity for space, convenience, and amenities in one beautiful package. Don't miss it!
